Based on the search results from LG's official website (lg.com), here's what I found regarding 4K monitors in 2026:

## Current 4K Monitor Offerings

LG offers UltraGear™ OLED gaming monitors for a 4K gaming experience, with OLED clarity, 240Hz refresh rates, and immersive curved 4K gaming monitors.

## Recent 2026 Announcements

LG introduced next-gen UltraGear evo™, with the UltraGear evo™ AI GM9 featuring Hyper Mini LED technology for ultra-high brightness and ultra-high resolution 5K gaming, with up to 1250nits of peak brightness and a 27-inch 5K display.

## Professional 4K Monitors

LG UltraFine™ monitors with Thunderbolt 3 & USB-C deliver stunning 4K/5K resolution and macOS compatibility; ideal for home, office, and business use.
